# Result Panel

A computed value, with exactly one thing inside it that talks.

In `library/components/result-panel/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-result`

## ARIA

- **the panel's region** — `role=status`
- **the copy button** — `aria-label`
- **a reason it will not act** — `aria-describedby`

## Keyboard

- `Tab` — the copy button is a stop; the value is a code element, not a control

**States:** empty — aria-disabled=true on the copy button, not the disabled attribute, so it keeps its tab stop and can explain itself

## Goes wrong when

- an output element for the value — it has an implicit role=status and reads the whole value on every change
- four live regions in one panel, each defensible on its own
- the copy button renamed to a past tense, so the control under your finger changes
- a tick as the only confirmation, correctly aria-hidden and therefore silent
- overflow-wrap:break-word for a long token, which wraps the text and leaves min-content alone (SC 1.4.10)
- a refusal announced in the region — nothing changed, so put the reason on the button

## API

- `AC.createResultPanel(root) -> { set, copy, refresh, destroy }`
- `AC.setResult(panel, state)`
- `AC.copyResult(btn, options)`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.10 2.5.3 2.5.8 4.1.2 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/live-regions/) · see also `notice`, `status-text`, `badge`
